seasonEducation.title: The Concept of Seasons
seasonEducation.subtitle: In Smartout, everything operates in Seasons. Reset budgets, update menus, and change setups seamlessly.
seasonEducation.whyBody: Instead of a continuously growing, unmanageable system, Smartout uses Seasons. A Season can be permanent (like "Core Operations") or temporal (like "Summer 2024"). This lets you archive past performance, assign seasonal staff cleanly, and switch entire operational configurations overnight.

seasonIdentity.title: Name Your First Season

seasonIdentity.name: Season Name
seasonIdentity.nameHint: Used internally and for your staff to identify the current active configuration.
seasonIdentity.permanentDesc: A continuous baseline configuration. You can always archive it or spin up a new season later.
seasonIdentity.temporalDesc: Strict temporal bounds (e.g. Summer 2024). Perfect for pop-ups or high-season changes.
